What this is

Paver installation in Lake Mary and the surrounding areas.

Blue Fox Landscape & Services offers commercial and residential paver installations to transform the current look of your property. Our professional installers can install driveways, walkways, patios, and more. Adding pavers will add to the aesthetics of your property.

Pavers are also the one hard surface that can be taken up and put back. A poured slab that cracks is a demolition job; a paver field that settles can be lifted and relaid. That matters in Central Florida, where the sand underneath moves.

Patios and more

What affects the scope

  • Square footage and the shape of the area
  • What has to come out first — concrete, turf or old pavers
  • Height at the garage door, the street and any doorways
  • Drainage, so water runs off rather than under
  • Edging and borders
  • Access for deliveries

Every quote is based on the property itself — the estimate visit is where the measuring happens, and it is free.

Questions

Before you call.

Can pavers go over an existing concrete driveway?

Sometimes — it depends on the condition of the slab and the height available at the garage door and the street. It is one of the first things we check on site.

Do you do commercial paver work?

Yes. Blue Fox offers commercial and residential paver installations.

How long does a paver driveway take?

It depends on square footage, access and what has to come out first. The estimate visit is where you get a real answer rather than a guess.
